integrity: The normalized equations, epidemiological domain, endemic-equilibrium structure, and Figure 5 limit-cycle example were checked against the complete source PDF. The identities were reconstructed from invariant-measure stationarity and independently replayed by the packaged symbolic checker; numerical integration was used only as a supplementary stress test, not as proof.
scientific_limitations: The invariant measure must have compact support contained in the strict epidemiological region \(0<X<Y<m/n\).
The strict mean trap requires two endemic roots inside the epidemiological interval and a non-Dirac invariant measure.
The result constrains invariant statistics and does not prove existence, uniqueness, stability, or period of a cycle.
The 2007 introducing article was not available in full text during comparison, leaving a bounded residual originality risk.
title: Finite-amplitude mean–variance shell for an oscillatory SI epidemic model
